vote.question: [US-NE - U.S. Senate]: Pete Ricketts (R) has received $20,423,187 in career campaign contributions (with $14,546,959 this cycle, alongside $32,742,719 in outside Super PAC support led by Defend American Jobs)—linked to "Private Equity, Speculative Finance & Real Estate Syndicate". Do you vote to formally rebuke Pete Ricketts for prioritizing private donor interests & failing to represent his constituents by upholding his core civic duties?
vote.futarchy_thesis: Elected stewards are entrusted with representing citizens, yet Pete Ricketts has amassed $20,423,187 in career contributions (with $14,546,959 this cycle, alongside $32,742,719 in outside Super PAC support led by Defend American Jobs)—prioritizing private corporate donors over constituent interests. This civic vote allows citizens to formally censure Pete Ricketts on the public ledger and direct 100% of the civic action escrow pool to local community restitution.

futarchy_pole_mechanics.leverage_ratio_statement: Every contribution directly empowers community-led funding. Once the campaign pool reaches $5,000, an automatic 60-day countdown begins. When the 60 days expire, all funds go directly to verified local charities or essential community services—zero platform cut.

bounty_if_passed.description: Community Fund for US-NE: Delivers 100% of funds to verified, IRS-registered 501(c)(3) public charities serving NE dedicated to affordable housing trusts, predatory-lending legal aid, and household debt relief. Verified local recipients: MOMENTUM HOUSING (US-EIN:470785685); HABITAT FOR HUMANITY INTERNATIONAL INC (US-EIN:363283625); MIDWEST HOUSING EQUITY GROUP INC (US-EIN:470767984); LEGAL AID OF NEBRASKA (US-EIN:470483506); MOSAIC (US-EIN:113669999). Once the pool hits $5,000, a 60-day timer starts. If YES wins, funds go to these charities; if NO wins, funds go to local community commons (fire/EMS, veterans, food banks).
bounty_if_passed.destination_criteria: All recipient organizations must be active, verified 501(c)(3) public charities registered in US-NE with clean IRS status and direct community impact. Approved charities: MOMENTUM HOUSING (US-EIN:470785685); HABITAT FOR HUMANITY INTERNATIONAL INC (US-EIN:363283625); MIDWEST HOUSING EQUITY GROUP INC (US-EIN:470767984); LEGAL AID OF NEBRASKA (US-EIN:470483506); MOSAIC (US-EIN:113669999).

trigger_conditions: Condition 1 (Activation): The campaign activates its 60-day countdown timer as soon as total contributions reach $5,000 USD (Base USDC).
Condition 2 (Resolution Period): The community vote runs for exactly 60 days from the moment the $5,000 threshold is reached.

Condition 3 (Payout): If YES receives 60% or more of votes, 100% of the funds are sent to the verified state non-profits; otherwise, 100% is sent to universal community services (fire/EMS, veterans, food banks).

bounty_if_no_wins.description: Community Commons for US-NE: If residents decide against the restitution fund, 100% of the funds go directly to essential local community services in US-NE (Volunteer Fire/EMS, Veterans' Care, Food Banks, and Disaster Relief). Recipient non-profits: FIRST RESPONDERS FOUNDATION (US-EIN:263499345); DUNHAM HOUSE INC (US-EIN:852199290); FOODBANK FOR THE HEARTLAND (US-EIN:470637701); RAPID RESPONSE OMAHAS DISASTER RELIEF TEAM (US-EIN:621873882); THE NEBRASKA MEDICAL CENTER (US-EIN:911858433).

bounty_if_no_wins.destination_criteria: MUST be an IRS-audited 501(c)(3) public charity in US-NE operating in non-ideological universal commons (NTEE M24 Fire & Rescue, M20 Disaster Relief, W30 Veterans, K31 Food Banks, E20/E22 Community Hospitals, O Youth Development) with zero partisan lobbying, chosen only where both sides of the political divide benefit. Eligible commons beneficiaries: FIRST RESPONDERS FOUNDATION (US-EIN:263499345); DUNHAM HOUSE INC (US-EIN:852199290); FOODBANK FOR THE HEARTLAND (US-EIN:470637701); RAPID RESPONSE OMAHAS DISASTER RELIEF TEAM (US-EIN:621873882); THE NEBRASKA MEDICAL CENTER (US-EIN:911858433).
